title: Divided Minds: Hemispheric Specialization & The Corpus Callosum
description: Unpack anatomical asymmetries, the 200 million callosal fibers, left-hemisphere linguistic dominance, and right-hemisphere spatial mastery.

slides.title: Hemispheric Asymmetry: Two Different Brains? 🌓
slides.content:
# Lateralization of Brain Function

While the human cerebral hemispheres appear superficially symmetrical, they display distinct anatomical asymmetries and functional specializations.

* **Planum Temporale Asymmetry**: The region underlying Wernicke's area is up to **5 times larger** in the left hemisphere in over 65% of humans, even in newborns!
* **The Great Fiber Bridge: The Corpus Callosum**:
  * A massive dense band of **200 to 300 million myelinated axonal fibers** connecting homologous regions of the left and right cerebral cortices.
  * Anatomical segments: **Rostrum**, **Genu** (anterior), **Body**, and **Splenium** (posterior, linking visual cortices).

slides.title: Left vs. Right: Specialized Processing Modes 🎨
slides.content:
## Contrasting Cognitive Styles

| Dimension | Left Hemisphere Dominance | Right Hemisphere Dominance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Language** | Speech production, grammar, lexical syntax, phonology | Emotional prosody, metaphors, humor, sarcasm |
| **Processing Mode** | Analytical, sequential, detail-oriented ('sees the trees') | Holistic, gestalt, spatial synthesis ('sees the forest') |
| **Motor / Perception** | Contralateral right-hand fine motor control | Contralateral left-hand motor control, mental rotation |
| **Face Processing** | Feature-by-feature matching (e.g. eye color) | Holistic configural facial recognition (FFA) |
| **Mathematics** | Exact arithmetic calculation, symbolic algebra | Approximate number estimation, geometric intuition |

quizData.question: Which cognitive capacity is predominantly lateralized to the right hemisphere in typical right-handed individuals?

options.text: Understanding emotional prosody, humor, and holistic spatial relations
Naming objects viewed in the right visual field

quizData.explanation: The right hemisphere excels in processing emotional intonation (prosody), figurative language (metaphors), and holistic visuospatial patterns.
